sentence: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam
hint: Third conditional: If + had + pp, would have + pp
explanation: Tercera condicional: If + pasado perfecto, would have + participio pasado. Nunca 'would had'.

sentence: I wish I had known about the deadline earlier
hint: Wish + past perfect for past regrets
explanation: Wish + pasado perfecto para arrepentimientos sobre el pasado: 'wish I had known'.

sentence: If they had left earlier, they would not have missed the flight
explanation: Tercera condicional en negativo: 'would not have missed'.

sentence: I wish I could speak Japanese fluently
hint: Wish + could for present wishes about ability
explanation: Wish + could + forma base para deseos sobre habilidades presentes.

sentence: If I had accepted that job, I would be living in London now
hint: Mixed conditional: past condition, present result
explanation: Condicional mixta: If + pasado perfecto (pasado), would + be + -ing (resultado presente).

sentence: If only I had listened to my parents' advice
explanation: 'If only' + pasado perfecto para expresar un fuerte arrepentimiento sobre el pasado.

sentence: He would have been promoted if he had worked harder
explanation: Tercera condicional con el resultado primero. 'Would have been' (no 'would had been').

sentence: I wish people would stop using so much plastic
hint: Wish + would for complaints about others
explanation: Wish + would para expresar molestia o quejas sobre el comportamiento de otras personas.

sentence: If we had not taken that shortcut, we would still be lost
explanation: Condicional mixta: condición pasada (had not taken), resultado presente (would be lost).

sentence: She wishes she had not said those things to him
explanation: Wish + pasado perfecto en negativo para arrepentirse de acciones pasadas.

sentence: If he were more confident, he would have applied for the position
hint: Mixed conditional: present condition, past result
explanation: Mixta: If + were (presente), would have + pp (resultado pasado). Se usa 'were', no 'was'.

sentence: I wish I did not have to work this weekend
explanation: Wish + pasado simple para deseos presentes: 'wish I didn't have to'.

sentence: If they had invested in that company, they would be rich now
explanation: Condicional mixta: condición pasada, resultado presente.

sentence: If only she had told us the truth from the beginning
explanation: 'If only' + pasado perfecto para un fuerte arrepentimiento pasado.

sentence: We would not have gotten lost if we had used the map
explanation: Tercera condicional en negativo con el resultado primero. 'Would not have' (nunca 'would had').

sentence: I wish the weather were better today
explanation: Wish + were (subjuntivo) para deseos presentes. Forma formal: 'were', no 'was'.

sentence: If she had not missed the interview, she might have gotten the job
explanation: Tercera condicional con 'might' en lugar de 'would' para expresar menos certeza.

sentence: He wishes he had traveled more when he was younger
explanation: Wish + pasado perfecto para arrepentimiento pasado con cláusula temporal.

sentence: If I had known you were coming, I would have prepared dinner
explanation: Tercera condicional con una cláusula incrustada: 'had known you were coming'.

sentence: I wish I were taller so I could reach the top shelf
explanation: Wish + were para un deseo presente + cláusula con 'so' para expresar propósito.

sentence: If we had booked the tickets earlier, they would have been cheaper
explanation: Tercera condicional: condición en pasado perfecto, resultado con would have + pp.

sentence: She wishes her neighbors would not play loud music at night
explanation: Wish + would para quejas sobre el comportamiento de otros.

sentence: If only we had more time to finish the project
explanation: 'If only' + pasado simple para deseos presentes (igual que 'wish').

sentence: If he had not been so careless, the accident would not have happened
explanation: Tercera condicional: doble negativo — 'had not been' y 'would not have happened'.

sentence: I wish I had started learning English when I was a child
explanation: Wish + pasado perfecto para arrepentimiento pasado con cláusula temporal.
